signInToSee: Sign in to see account settings.
inviteOnce: Copy this code now. It is shown once.
noInvitesYet: You have not invited anyone yet.
projectsLead: Work and personal systems, stored in the repository as markdown.
showSenderNamesHint: Off by default. Notifications never include message text.
notificationsHint: Alert when a message arrives and Chat is in the background. Install Chat or keep the tab open so the browser can show them.
relayOnlyHint: Route calls and files through the server so contacts never see your IP. Slower.
directOnlyHint: Send only straight to people who are online. Nothing is stored on the server.
changeVaultPasswordLead: Only the local key wrapper changes. Your chats and identity stay the same.
vaultPasswordSame: The new password must differ from the current one.
recoveryKeyHint: A second way to unlock this vault if you forget the password. Shown once.
recoveryKeyLead: Write this key down or store it in a password manager. Anyone with it can unlock the vault on this device.
copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it manually.
devicesLead: Browsers and apps signed in to this account. Revoke any you do not recognize.
linkDeviceHint: Copy your identity and chats to another browser or phone.
pairingInstructions: On the other device sign in, choose â€œTransfer chatsâ€, and enter these codes or scan the QR. Then confirm here.
revokeLastConfirm: This is your last trusted device. Revoking it means no device can transfer your chats to a new one. Continue?
twoFactorHint: Ask for a one-time code from an authenticator app on every sign-in.
twoFactorOn: Enabled. You can set up a new authenticator at any time.
totpLead: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app (Aegis, 1Password, Google Authenticatorâ€¦), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
totpSecret: Or enter this secret by hand
recoveryCodesLead: Each code signs you in once if you lose the authenticator. Store them somewhere safe; they are not shown again.
codeWrong: That code is wrong or has expired.
challengeExpired: The sign-in took too long. Enter your password again.
lockHint: Forget the key until the vault password is entered again. Nothing is deleted.
securityLead: Everything below lives on this device. The server never sees your vault password.
signInLead: Invite-only. Your account password signs you in; a separate vault password protects chats on each device.
accountPasswordHint: 8-128 characters. This is not your vault password.
signInInChatFor2fa: This account uses two-factor sign-in. Sign in from chat.ma.cyou.
unlockLead: Enter the vault password you set on this device. It never leaves this browser.
createVault: Create a vault on this device
createVaultLead: Chats and files are encrypted here, in this browser. Pick a password only you know. It is not sent to the server.
vaultPasswordsDiffer: The two passwords do not match.
vaultNotAccountPassword: Do not reuse your account password. If the server were ever breached, your chats would still be safe.
vaultExplainWhat: The vault is an encrypted store in this browser. It holds your chats, files, and the keys other people use to write to you.
vaultExplainWhy: Your account password is checked by the server, so the server knows it. The vault password never leaves this device, which is why it must be different: nobody but you can open your history.
vaultExplainForget: If you forget it, unlock with a recovery key or transfer chats from another device. Otherwise the history on this device cannot be recovered.
vaultPasswordSeparate: Stays on this device. Different from your account password.
wrongVaultAccount: This vault belongs to a different account.
pickConversation: Pick a conversation. Messages stay on this device, encrypted.
emptyContacts: Add a friend by username or create a group to start.
deleteMessageConfirm: Delete this message from this device only? Other people keep their copy.
serverOverloaded: The server is busy right now. Wait a bit or send it while the other person is online.
registerOverloaded: The server is busy right now. Try again in a bit.
inviteInvalid: That invite code is not valid.
notAllowed: You are not allowed to do that.
deviceUntrusted: This device is not trusted yet. Transfer chats from another device or start fresh.
tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
sessionExpired: Your session ended. Sign in again.
networkError: No connection. Check your network and try again.
fileGone: This file is no longer on the server.
recipientNoVault: Their vault key is not on the server yet, so the message cannot be encrypted. Ask them to open Chat with the vault unlocked.
peerOfflineDirect: They are offline. Direct only is on, so this was not sent through the server.
fileTooLarge: This file is too large to store on the server.
fileOfflineLarge: {name} is offline. Files over {size} go directly between devices, so keep this page open until they come online.
cloudStorageLead: Files waiting for someone who is offline. {limit} in total, counted once even in a group. Messages are not included.
cloudQuotaHit: This send needs {need} more, and {room} is free ({used} of {limit}). Remove a file below, then send again.
cloudExpires: A file leaves the cloud after 24 hours, when everyone has downloaded it, or when you remove it.
cloudEmpty: Nothing is waiting in the cloud.
cloudStageFailed: This browser could not prepare the file for the cloud. Try a smaller file or another browser.
fileNoLongerHere: This file is no longer on this device, so it cannot be shared again.
fileMissing: No one who is online still has this file.
fileSenderOfflineLong: No one who has this file is online right now. Try again when they are.
cloudDirectOnly: This file is larger than {limit}, so it is not stored in the cloud. Sending it to people who are online. Someone who comes online before the transfer finishes can still receive it.
cloudNobodyOnline: This file is larger than {limit} and nobody else is online, so it cannot be sent.
cloudSendDirectHint: Or skip the cloud and send only to people who are online. Someone who is still offline when the transfer finishes will not get the file.
fileSenderOffline: No one with this file is online
fileSessionOnly: Shared while this page is open
transferBusy: A transfer is already running. Wait for it to finish or cancel it.
storageLimitHint: Total for chats, files, and files waiting to be sent. When it is exceeded, the oldest files are removed first. 0 means no limit.
cleanStorageHint: Remove cached files older than 7 days. Messages stay.
cleanStorageEmpty: Nothing to remove. Cached files are newer than 7 days.
localDataLead: Everything Chat keeps in this browser, including data from older versions.
wipeLocalHint: Removes every chat, file, and vault from this browser. Your account and other devices are untouched.
wipeItemChats: All chats and message history on this device
wipeItemLegacy: Vaults from older versions of Chat
wipeItemCache: Offline cache and settings for this site
wipeKeepsAccount: Your account, contacts, and other devices are not affected. Chats that exist only here cannot be recovered.
clearHistoryConfirm: Delete this chat's messages from this device?
shareUnavailable: Sharing isn't available in this browser. Use Download to save the file.
feedbackBefore: If you find a bug or have an idea, write to me here,
identityMismatch: This device's identity does not match the account. Transfer chats from a trusted device instead of replacing it.
transferAsk: Do you want to transfer your chats from another device?
transferAskLead: Enter the code shown on your other device. Chats already on this device stay here, and both devices receive whatever the other is missing. The server never sees your vault password or history.
transferDone: Chats are synchronizing. Messages that exist on only one device are copied to the other.
unlockBeforeSync: Unlock this device first so the chats already here can be kept.
waitingPeer: Waiting until the other device is online.
newGroupLead: Up to 20 people from your contacts. The owner and admins can add more later.
transferOwnershipConfirm: Make {name} the owner? You will become an admin.
ownerMustTransfer: Make someone else the owner before leaving, or delete the group.
leaveGroupConfirm: Leave this group? You will need an invite from a member to come back.
deleteGroupConfirm: Delete this group for everyone? Members keep the messages already on their devices.
groupNotContact: You can only add people from your contacts.
